title: Enchanted Tool Expansion
body:
Enchanted Tool Expansion adds new tool-focused enchantments that make everyday mining, digging, and farming faster while still using normal tools and durability.

* Excavator I–III is for shovels and lets the player dig larger shovel-block areas, with higher levels reaching up to a 3x3 area, and it can also turn dirt-type blocks into paths in the same level-based area. 
  
* Quarry I–III is for pickaxes and expands stone mining, letting higher levels mine larger tunnel-style areas up to 3x3. 
  
* Harvester I–III is for hoes and improves farming by tilling dirt-type blocks in larger areas and harvesting mature crops in an area, dropping the crops naturally while replanting only when the player has the correct seeds or crop item available.

* More features planned for other tools so check back occasionally to make sure you dont miss any of the added tool enchantments.
